tools.name: shred_rfp
tools.description: Shred an RFP or solicitation into a numbered requirement list with a gap preview. Paste text or upload a PDF or DOCX. AI extraction can miss requirements and every requirement needs human review. This starts an analysis job and returns a result token; call get_shred_result with the token to read the

tools.name: get_shred_result
tools.description: Read the result of a shred_rfp job using its result token. Returns the status and, when complete, the numbered requirements, the gap preview, and any warnings. Free, no sign-in.

tools.name: check_bid_fit
tools.description: Run a bid/no-bid fit check on a solicitation: five questions scored 0 to 2, for a fit read of Strong fit, Worth a closer look, or Likely pass. This is a fit score, never a win prediction. Needs the solicitation text or file plus a short title, source, and the five answers. Starts an analysis job and

tools.name: get_bid_check_result
tools.description: Read the result of a check_bid_fit job using its result token. Returns the status and, when complete, the fit verdict, the score out of 10, the factor breakdown, the top reasons, and the top gaps. Free, no sign-in.

tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Search live SAM.gov federal opportunities from the past 364 days. Returns up to 25 notices per page with title, agency, deadline, NAICS, PSC, set-aside, and the canonical SAM.gov link. Federal notices only; no contract value bands are published. Free, no sign-in. Limited to 10 searches per day, shar

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Read one SAM.gov opportunity by its notice URL or 32-character notice ID, including the notice description text when SAM.gov returns it. Descriptions are not complete solicitation packages; attachments are not imported. Free, no sign-in.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List the knowledge organizations (company evidence libraries) the signed-in TenderCrest user belongs to. Needs a TenderCrest account.

tools.name: list_evidence
tools.description: List the signed-in user's own company evidence for one organization: uploaded source documents and saved answers with their approval state. Only returns evidence the user's organization owns. Needs a TenderCrest account.

tools.name: read_evidence_source
tools.description: Read one evidence source document and its extracted text chunks, for the signed-in user's own organization. Needs a TenderCrest account.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Search the signed-in user's own company evidence for one organization by meaning, using the same semantic search as the web app. Returns matching evidence with citations. Needs a TenderCrest account.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List the signed-in TenderCrest user's own proposals (projects), newest first. Needs a TenderCrest account.

tools.name: read_proposal
tools.description: Read one of the signed-in user's own proposals in full: project state, sections, requirements, evidence decisions, jobs, files, activity, approvals, and readiness. Read-only. Needs a TenderCrest account.

tools.name: list_proposal_records
tools.description: List saved records for one of the signed-in user's own proposals: jobs, files, activity, notifications, assessments, or approvals. Read-only. Needs a TenderCrest account.

tools.name: get_proposal_revision
tools.description: Read one saved revision of the signed-in user's own proposal. Read-only. Needs a TenderCrest account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shred_rfp, search_opportunities, get_opportunity, list_proposal_records · Private data: shred_rfp, get_shred_result, check_bid_fit, get_bid_check_result, list_evidence, read_evidence_source, read_proposal, list_proposal_records · Public sink: shred_rfp · Destructive: check_bid_fit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shred_rfp, search_opportunities, get_opportunity, list_proposal_records · Private data: shred_rfp, get_shred_result, check_bid_fit, get_bid_check_result, list_evidence, read_evidence_source, read_proposal, list_proposal_records · Public sink: shred_rfp · Destructive: check_bid_fit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
